from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,datetime,json,hashlib,zipfile,shutil
root=Path('/Users/itayzrihan/Documents/PoCut')
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=root)
dst=root/'.local'/('before-earshot-deepseek-merge-'+datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S'));dst.mkdir(parents=True)
(dst/'staged.patch').write_bytes(git('diff','--cached','--binary'))
(dst/'unstaged.patch').write_bytes(git('diff','--binary'))
index=Path(git('rev-parse','--git-path','index').decode().strip());index=index if index.is_absolute() else root/index
shutil.copy2(index,dst/'index')
paths=set()
for args in [('diff','--name-only','-z'),('diff','--cached','--name-only','-z'),('ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','-z')]:
 paths.update(x.decode() for x in git(*args).split(b'\0') if x)
hashes={}
with zipfile.ZipFile(dst/'local-files.zip','w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
 for name in sorted(paths):
  p=root/name
  if p.is_file():
   hashes[name]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest();z.write(p,name)
manifest={'head':git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip(),'indexSha256':hashlib.sha256(index.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'files':hashes,'paths':sorted(paths)}
(dst/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
print(dst);print('Saved original index, staged/unstaged patches and',len(hashes),'local files')
